_help: The minimap window in 1366x768 space; x,y is where it opens. The two side panels are listW x listH and filterW x filterH. The box follows the map: the canvas art plus the frame borders (borderX left and right, smallTop/bigTop, bottomH), floored by the smallest map area (minArtW/minArtH; a smaller canvas sits centred on black) and, in the large layout, by the two names (streetX/nameX). rowRight,rowY,rowPitch place the three buttons on the header, right aligned; btnSize is their art size. zoomX,zoomY,zoomPitch place the minus/plus pair that switches the layout. listW,listH are the NPC list art (184x286), filterW,filterH the filter art (133x286). panelGap,panelY place them on the right of the window; panelGap is also the 1px overlap between the two panels, filterRowH is the height of a filter row hit box and filterHitPad lifts it. markX,markY,markW are the map icon slot of the large header; streetX/streetY,nameX/nameY the two names. listTop,listRowH,listIconX,listIconDy,listTextX,listTextDy place an NPC row (the official list starts at 59, below its sort dropdown; we do not draw that box, so the list starts at 30); listCloseX,listCloseY and filterCloseX,filterCloseY the two X buttons. The NPC row icon sits at listIconX inside the row (the art origin is not used). filterTextDx/Dy and filterCheckDx/Dy nudge a filter row; filterTextPx is its name size.
